mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 77 degrees with partly cloudy skies, perfect for a walk along the Military Ridge State Trail.

The Verona Senior Center is actively seeking volunteers to help with various services. You will need to commit to two sessions per month, and please be aware some roles require light physical activity like climbing stairs.
Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or visit the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Yoga at Insight Wellness or the UGM event at Epic Systems.
In a report from August 5, police tracked down a man with an active warrant on Whalen Road who initially tried to flee from officers.
Today, the Culver's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. They are open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a sweet snack.
